1. Parties. This lease is made between Lena Ortiz of 18 Quarry Lane, Port Maren, who is called the Landlord, and Mark Ellison, who is called the Tenant. The Landlord lets the premises through her managing agent, Pierline Property Management, whose office is at 4 Customs Row, Port Maren. In this lease the managing agent acts for the Landlord, and a notice given to the managing agent counts as a notice given to the Landlord.
2. Premises. The premises are the furnished flat known as Unit 4B on the fourth floor of 27 Harbor Street, with the use of mailbox 4B in the ground floor lobby and one space in the bicycle store. The furniture and fittings are listed in the schedule and inventory attached to this lease.
3. Term. The term begins on 1 September 2025 and ends on 28 February 2026. It can be extended only by a new agreement in writing signed by both parties. If the Tenant stays after the end of the term without a new agreement, rent is payable for each extra day at the same rate.
4. Use. The Tenant shall use the premises as a private home for one person. The Tenant shall not run a business from the premises, sublet them or take in a lodger.
